discovery.note: Every P1 threshold below was chosen on these sessions. They are excluded from scoring.

data.exits: SELL submit + fill joined by order_id from ai_reports/fills/<day>.jsonl, submit between 09:30 and 16:00 ET
data.quotes_trades: Alpaca historical SIP quotes and trades from t0-30 s to t0+collar+2 s (data key, after the close)
data.reason: close_reason of the desk outcome (ai_reports/tapes/<day>/outcomes.jsonl) whose exit_time is nearest the submit, within 20 s; none -> unknown

market_routes: reason urgent: dead_trade, no_progress, double_check, fill_through_stop, exh_falling_flatten, stale_data
no IEX quote <= 15 s old at t0
IEX book one cent wide (ask - bid <= $0.0105)
IEX spread < 4.0 bp of the IEX mid
policy_P1.market_route_scoring: delta 0: the fill the desk actually got
policy_P1.passive_route: sell limit at the IEX mid rounded UP to the cent at t0 = submitted_at
policy_P1.fill_rule: chosen by calibration (amended_1 B2): trade_through or bid_cross, both on SIP
policy_P1.bail_rule: if, before a fill, an IEX quote shows the bid at or below the starting IEX bid minus $0.01, sell at the SIP bid 3 s later
policy_P1.timeout_rule: unfilled and not bailed at t0+collar (capped 16:00:00): sell at the SIP bid 3 s later (capped 16:00:00)
policy_P1.delta_bp: (simulated price - actual fill) / actual fill x 1e4; positive = P1 better

metric: mean delta_bp per eligible exit (market-routed = 0), calibrated fill rule, 10 s collar; t day-clustered

verdict_rules.VOID: calibration fails (no rule within 10 points with kappa >= 0.30); or < 300 scored eligible exits; or > 10% of eligible exits unscored; or < 50 passive; or either half < 100 scored or < 25 passive
verdict_rules.PASS: pooled mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2.0, AND each half mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 1.0, AND per-session means positive on >= 60% of sessions, AND the 2026-09-18..09-28 block mean >= 0
verdict_rules.FAIL: pooled mean <= 0, OR either half mean < 0 with |day-clustered t| >= 1
verdict_rules.PROMISING: pooled mean > 0 and both halves > 0 but the PASS bar is missed

reported_beside_never_headline: per-passive-exit delta and fill / bail / timeout counts
per exit reason and per spread band
known_limits: Actual fills are Alpaca PAPER fills; a real book may fill market exits worse and limits less often.
Strict trade-through is the only queue model; desk size is 1-30 shares, so it is a fair proxy here, not at real size.
Held-out sessions ran other desk configs; P1 only routes the exit the desk chose, so the comparison is per exit.
Reason join by time can mislabel when one name exits twice within 20 s.
rules: No threshold, collar or reason list changes after scoring starts. Amendments only before the first held-out score, each with the operator's yes.

amended_1.B1_decisions_on_iex: Route, limit and bail are decided from historical IEX quotes (what the desk sees live, alpaca_bar_feed=iex), no older than 15 s; no fresh IEX quote -> market. SIP is used only for the outcome (prints, bids at execution).
amended_1.B2_fill_model_calibration: Before the held-out score, the desk's 74 real SELL_LIMIT mid orders (10/05-10/15, 25 filled = 34%) are scored under two fill rules: trade_through (a SIP print above the limit) and bid_cross (the SIP bid at or above the limit). The PRIMARY rule is the one whose predicted fill rate is closest to the actual rate; if neither is within 10 points, the study is VOID. Calibration uses only those limit orders and their windows (submit to the fallback market sell, else 10 s); it never sees a P1 delta.
amended_1.M3_exclusions: Market sells sent within 30 s after a SELL_LIMIT on the same name are excluded (selected on adverse moves).
amended_1.M4_day_clustered_t: All t-statistics are over per-session mean deltas, not trades.
amended_1.M5_latency: t0 = the broker's submitted_at. Bail and timeout execute at the SIP bid 3 s (one book tick) after the trigger.
amended_1.M6_paper_delay: Exits whose paper fill took more than 10 s after submit are excluded. delta2 (vs the SIP bid at t0) is reported beside the primary.
amended_1.m7_eod: eod_liquidate routes to market; no wait runs past 16:00:00 ET.
amended_1.m8_halves: VOID unless each half has >= 100 scored and >= 25 passive exits.
amended_1.m9_left_overbought: left_overbought (0 discovery exits, ~89 held out) routes passive by the rules; reported as its own group.
amended_1.m10_rounding: The limit is the IEX mid rounded UP to the cent (Decimal).
amended_1.m11: 5 s collar and the non-primary fill rule are printed as SECONDARY, never a verdict. Junk symbols (TEST, non-ticker) are dropped.

run_after: the double-check replays finish (Alpaca budget; 6 parallel fetches hit 429 on 11/03)

amended_2.untouched_sub_bar: PASS also requires the 2026-09-18..09-28 block's mean delta >= 0.
amended_2.marketable_limit: A limit at or under the SIP bid at t0 fills at once at the SIP bid; a fill on a print or a bid cross books max(limit, SIP bid at that instant).
amended_2.calibration_agreement: The chosen rule must also have Cohen's kappa >= 0.30 against the real fills, else VOID. Window for an order with no fallback: 12 s (cross_sec 10 + one book tick).
amended_2.calibration_locked: The calibration result is computed once, before the held-out score, and cannot be rerun or replaced afterwards.
amended_2.per_reason: The verdict output lists n and mean delta per exit reason (left_overbought among them).
amended_2.beside_never_headline: tools/exit_arm_score.py (the G2 live randomized market-vs-mid A/B, 10/05-10/15) is reported beside the result: the only real-venue evidence.
